description: This file defines game dimension constants, utility functions for responsive sizing, and configuration presets for a game frontend. It manages logical and render sizes, viewport constraints, and provides functions to compute appropriate rendering sizes based on viewport and container dimensions.

methods.name: getSizePresetFromQuery
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters to retrieve a size preset ('small', 'medium', 'large') based on the 'size' parameter.

methods.name: computeRenderSize
methods.description: Calculates the optimal width, height, and scale for rendering the game area based on container width, viewport height, and optional preset scaling, while respecting aspect ratio and size bounds.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a value within specified minimum and maximum bounds.
